input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(deploy-cloudflare): CF Workers shims and custom esbuild bundler

Adds build-worker.mjs (custom esbuild pre-bundler) and a set of CF-safe
shims to replace Node.js APIs not available in the Workers runtime:
- node-http/https/net/tls/fs/fs-promises/child_process/readline/os/http2
- pino, pino-http → console-backed logger shim
- express → zero-dep CF Router shim (with router.param stub)
- server/src/middleware/logger.ts → CF-safe shim (esbuild plugin)
- server/src/version.ts → CF-safe shim (no createRequire/package.json)
- dotenv → no-op shim (CF env vars come from wrangler bindings)
- multer → no-op shim (CF file uploads use Request.formData())
- process global polyfill for hrtime, cwd, chdir, exit in banner

Adds .dev.vars for local-trusted mode, wrangler.toml Hyperdrive
localConnectionString, and dev/deploy scripts in package.json.

GET /api/health returns {"status":"ok","platform":"cloudflare",...} locally.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
